description_en: Queries the diagnostic results of the storage layer
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-worker-detection --db-cluster-id am-xxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 2011-06-01T16:00Z --end-time 2024-04-25T02:04Z --lang zh --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeWorkerDetection

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查询集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

You can query data only within the last 15 days
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 仅支持查看最近15天内的数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
指定请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang
